en: The image is a sepia-toned photographic portrait of a distinguished man with a mustache and goatee, dressed formally in a suit adorned with various medals and decorations. The photograph is set in a studio with a simple background. There is a handwritten signature in the top-right corner and ornate Cyrillic script along the bottom edge, accompanied by a small royal or municipal coat of arms.
